Diversify into gold, EM currencies, and multi-currency bonds; monitor Dutch CB gold moves as leading indicator

market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Fed hike expectations and oil-driven inflation. Equities likely choppy with sector rotation from chips to energy/power. Gold dips are buying opportunities. EM currencies continue outperformance. Watch for oil breaking $100 as binary catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains intact but maturing—expect rotation from chips to infrastructure, power, and applications. Geopolitical energy risk is structural, supporting energy and metals. De-dollarization and gold repatriation are multi-year trends. K-shaped economy persists, favoring quality and value over growth-at-any-price.
